inventive_nucleus: The optical filter array reduces signal degradation under low perfusion conditions by increasing the signal-to-noise ratio of the PPG sensor.

claim_versions.claim: The optical filter array is configured to operate in conjunction with a processing unit to reduce signal degradation under low perfusion conditions by adaptively fusing PPG signals based on perfusion index (PI) thresholds, thereby increasing the signal-to-noise ratio of the PPG sensor.
